target_problem: combine functional graph compression and affine-hull rank without nonlinear substitution into neighboring gates
conditional_implication: Given a polynomially checkable certificate with f distinct acyclic functional heads and rank R of additional root-supported affine-hull equations, eta=n-f-R variables of freedom remain. The hybrid relaxed domain has exactly 2^eta assignments, at most R affine output blocks are consumed, and m>n leaves more than eta residual outputs, yielding deterministic O(2^eta poly(N)) avoidance.
frontier_reason: The explicit connected exact-stretch family has eta=3 while V97 lambda=8k, V101 mu=k+3, V102 beta=Theta(k) with beta>=3k, and V103 nu=4k+1. The detector for an optimal hybrid certificate remains open.

bridge_lemmas.name: functional graph and affine-hull relaxations can be imposed simultaneously when affine equations are root-supported
a rank-R root system below an f-head functional DAG leaves exactly 2^(n-f-R) relaxed assignments
the number of retained affine output blocks is at most R
m>n leaves more than eta=n-f-R residual output coordinates
a supplied hybrid certificate is polynomially verifiable
the explicit 0x1e plus 0x16 family has eta=3
the same family has lambda=8k, mu=k+3, beta>=3k, and nu=4k+1
an optimal or eta-FPT hybrid certificate can be found on arbitrary circuits

closed_route: treating functional-DAG compression and affine-hull rank as mutually exclusive preprocessing stages
surviving_route: detect or approximate hybrid certificates, or identify a stronger normal form for balanced-nonaffine high-eta residual systems
current_gap: The algorithm is constructive given a certificate, but V104 does not provide a polynomial-time or FPT procedure parameterized only by eta for finding an optimal certificate on an arbitrary circuit.
stop_rule: Do not promote V105 for another supplied-certificate restatement. Require a detector/approximation theorem, a strictly stronger polynomially discoverable invariant, or a scalable obstruction showing hybrid-certificate detection is itself hard.
external_validation_target: prior-art review of combined functional-dependency and affine-rank relaxations in range avoidance, CSP backdoors, algebraic CSPs, proof-complexity generators, and remote-point constructions
